snapshot.title: Full-screen galaxy map with planet candidates on mission setup
snapshot.description: Mission setup (SpaceMap) should show galaxy view full-screen, highlight planet candidate stars awaiting classification, and open annotation/classification screen on tap. Also fix GDScript parse errors in TutorialCoachOverlay, ClassificationConsensusNotification, and earth_base_1.
